questions.question: Which screens are in scope for the visual design pass: every user-facing template, only the authenticated screens linked from the shared shell, or a smaller screen inventory you will provide?
questions.recommended: All user-facing templates, including registration, dashboard, checklist, emergency-access, notification, profile/activity, and Vault screens.
questions.why: The specification measures unnamed primary screens, while the repository contains multiple template families whose inclusion changes the implementation and review scope.

questions.question: What visual reference should govern the refreshed colors, typography, spacing, surfaces, and component states?

options.label: A
options.text: Use a supplied brand guide, design file, or approved visual reference

options.label: B
options.text: Have the implementer propose a visual system from the existing app for explicit human approval before broad application

questions.why: The ticket and repository provide no visual reference, so the acceptance baseline must either be supplied or approved before the design can be judged.

questions.question: Which viewport widths or ranges must be treated as supported and included in responsive verification?
questions.recommended: Desktop widths from 1280px down to 768px, plus mobile widths of 375px and 320px.
questions.why: The specification defers to existing supported viewports, but the repository exposes only a 600px CSS breakpoint and does not define the actual verification targets.

questions.question: What repeatable evidence is required for visual states and responsive flows beyond the existing Django test suite?

options.label: A
options.text: Manual review against an approved visual checklist plus the existing automated tests

options.label: B
options.text: Automated browser tests for key states and viewports plus manual visual approval

options.label: C
options.text: Screenshot or visual-regression tests for the in-scope screens plus manual visual approval

questions.why: The repository has no browser or screenshot test setup, while the specification requires repeatable verification of focus, states, workflows, and viewport behavior.
